thread:
Liam O'Neill: Heads up 2 FinServe vendor security rep emailed asking for: latest redacted penetration test, authenticated Qualys export, remediation timeline, and a summary attestation. They want evidence for SIG/CAIQ review.
Priya Shah: Can we confirm the requested scope? Are they asking for hosted Redwood API endpoints only or dedicated/POC infra too? Need to avoid leaking customer tenant names.
Samir Kulkarni: They specifically referenced 'demo.dedicated.redwood' and our hosted inference control plane. We should only include assets owned by Redwood (no customer data). I'll prepare a sanitized network diagram of the POC VPC and a short description of IAM boundaries.
secops-bot: auto: ticket RSK-789 created for FinServe evidence request. Owner: Priya Shah. Due: 1748476412.
Priya Shah: For the pen-test, redaction rules: remove internal hostnames, IPs from private ranges, exploit PoC payloads, and any screenshots with tokens. We can include CVE IDs, CVSS scores, and remediation status.
Liam O'Neill: FinServe also asked for SSAE/SOC2 type II report and a high-level CAIQ map. Can we provide a completed CAIQ matrix with references to our controls docs?
Samir Kulkarni: I can export the CAIQ answers (sanitized) and link to our Controls page. For SOC2, we can share the cover letter + SOC2 PDF after NDAs. Legal will want the DPA/DDA signed before SOC artifacts.
Priya Shah: Remediation timeline expectations: we'll mark issues CVSS 3.0+ as high priority. For CVSS >=7.0 we should commit ETA (date or M/M YYYY) and status (fixed/in-progress/mitigated). I'll generate the remediation CSV with columns: id, title, cvss, cwe, status, remediation_eta, notes.
secops-bot: auto: note added to RSK-789 2 "Include Qualys authenticated scan export and scans summary. No raw logs. Use presigned downloads."
Samir Kulkarni: Upload plan: secure S3 path s3://redwood-secure/finserve/RSK-789/ . We'll hand out presigned HTTPS links (48h expiry) and a short MD5 checksum for each file. Links will be created by SecOps. No direct email attachments.
Liam O'Neill: FinServe: @finserve-vendor said they'd prefer a single zipped bundle on a presigned link and a short attestation. They will not accept unredacted attachments.
Priya Shah: Attestation language draft: "Redwood Inference attests that the attached redacted penetration test report and vulnerability scan exports reflect findings for Redwood-managed infrastructure as of the report date. No customer data or exploit payloads are included in the artifacts." Legal to sign.
Samir Kulkarni: I'll prepare the zipped bundle: pen-test-redacted.pdf, qualys-export.csv, remediation-timeline.csv, caiq-sanitized.xlsx, poc-network-diagram.pdf. ETA for upload: EOD today.
secops-bot: auto: presigned links will be posted to ticket RSK-789 after Legal approval. Access logs will be retained for 90 days.
Liam O'Neill: Question from FinServe in thread: "Can you commit to post-remediation verification and provide screenshots of patches applied?"
Priya Shah: We can offer a re-scan within 7 business days after they request it; re-scans beyond the included support window are billable. For confirmed patch evidence we can provide package version numbers and patch dates, not raw server screenshots.
Samir Kulkarni: Legal approved attestation language at 1748391200. I'll trigger upload now.
secops-bot: auto: uploads complete at 1748392000. Files:
- https://redwood-secure.example/finserve/RSK-789/pen-test-redacted.pdf?sig=XXX
- https://redwood-secure.example/finserve/RSK-789/qualys-export.csv?sig=YYY
- https://redwood-secure.example/finserve/RSK-789/remediation-timeline.csv?sig=ZZZ
- https://redwood-secure.example/finserve/RSK-789/caiq-sanitized.xlsx?sig=AAA
- https://redwood-secure.example/finserve/RSK-789/poc-network-diagram.pdf?sig=BBB
Priya Shah: Uploaded remediation timeline: top-line notes 5 issues CVSS >=7 (2 fixed, 3 in progress), all with CVE refs and expected fix dates. I included mitigation steps for any long-lead items.
Liam O'Neill: Sent the presigned bundle to FinServe along with the attestation and CAIQ. They responded: "Thanks. We'll review and let us know if we need a live walkthrough or SOC contact." They requested a re-scan estimate for three medium/high items.
Priya Shah: I'll schedule a paid re-scan quote and propose 5-7 business day turnaround after PO. I'll also offer a live walkthrough with SecOps if they want to validate counters.
Samir Kulkarni: Closing notes: do not share raw logs or exploit PoCs without SOC oversight and a signed DPA/NDA. All artifacts shared are redacted and access-controlled.
Liam O'Neill: Great work team, keeping this one moving. I'll follow up with FinServe if they ask for the walkthrough. :thumbsup:
